name: flux-write
description: File writer for the Flux series. Overwrite, append, replace a line range, move or mkdir from one command.
notes: `verbs` is empty ON PURPOSE, not yet-to-be-written. `.fwrite` was declined on 2026-07-04: stream-to-file is already served by `.save` / `.append` / `.tee`, which are pure Rust and work on iOS, whereas flux-write depends on fork and does not -- so a verb here would be strictly worse than the builtin it duplicates. Its distinctive modes (replace / move / mkdir) are file operations rather than a stream sink, so they do not fit the verb shape at all. Still a first-class pipe as a plain command: `flux-write PATH --mode append`. ⚠️ 2026-09-02: `side_effects` を `true` から `["fs:cwd"]` にした（`#24`）—— 🚨 `true` は「危ないから触るな」しか伝えず、`flux-conform` が一切撃たなくなり、**7 マスが未判定のまま `sink` 詐称が 14 ヶ月生き延びた**。⭐ 何が変わるかを言えば、検査器は「専用の一時ディレクトリを cwd にして撃つ」を*導ける*。 📌 `docs/CONFORMANCE.md` 原則②「免除は**測り方**を変えてよいが、**測るかどうか**を変えてはいけない」。
